guide.title: Quick Start Guide
guide.welcome: Welcome to BidPilot! Follow these steps to turn source materials into a reviewable, exported deliverable:
guide.step1Desc: Click "+ New Project" and pick a scenario package (e.g. BidPilot).
guide.step2Desc: Open project -> Bundles tab -> register bundle -> upload PDF/DOCX.
guide.step3Desc: Deliverables -> create one. Drafting tab -> generate sections with AI.
guide.step4Desc: Review tab -> comment, approve or reject each section.
guide.step5Desc: When all sections approved, Export tab -> download DOCX.
guide.step6Desc: Audit tab -> see every event. System tab -> execution traces & costs.

detail.reingestAllDesc: This will re-process all bundles that haven't been ingested yet. Continue?

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.emptyDesc: Extract or add requirements from your documents.

ledger.title: Requirement Ledger
ledger.description: Control every tender obligation through ownership, evidence, verification, and source-backed traceability.
ledger.noMatchesDescription: Change or clear the filters to return to the full ledger.
ledger.loadFailed: The Requirement Ledger could not be loaded
ledger.loadFailedDescription: This is a service error, not an empty project. Refresh or try again shortly.
ledger.inspectorDescription: Inspect the original clause, evidence, claims, decisions, and ownership before closing this requirement.
ledger.detailLoadFailed: The requirement trace could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
ledger.noEvidence: No evidence is linked. This requirement cannot be closed with a factual claim yet.
ledger.noClaims: No response claim has been created for this requirement.
ledger.verifyClaimEvidenceFirst: Verify the linked evidence before verifying this factual claim.
ledger.noDecisions: No exception, waiver, or risk decision has been requested.
ledger.traceRule: A requirement becomes covered only after a factual claim is backed by verified evidence. UI actions never override this rule.
ledger.assignmentConflict: {{items}} changed while you were assigning work. The ledger was refreshed; review and try again.
ledger.assignmentFailed: Failed to update assignment. The requirement may have changed; refresh and retry.
ledger.packOutdated: This pack is out of date. Generate a new pack before downloading.

drafting.title: Draft Section
drafting.placeholder: Enter section key to draft (e.g. technical-approach)
drafting.noEvidence: No evidence linked to this section. Consider adding source citations before approving.
drafting.missingEvidence: No evidence linked. Claims may not be verified.

knowledge.title: Project Knowledge
knowledge.description: A governed, source-backed knowledge ledger that the project Agent can retrieve after review.
knowledge.scopeHint: Only approved project-shared knowledge is available to the workflow Agent.
knowledge.graphExtractionHint: Uses only this approved knowledge record and its sources. The result remains reviewable and never enters the graph or Agent context automatically.
knowledge.graphExtractionAlreadyQueued: An entity-relation proposal for this knowledge is already running or ready for review
knowledge.graphExtractionFailed: Could not start the entity-relation proposal
knowledge.graphProposalNoRelations: This proposal contains no sufficiently grounded relations.
knowledge.graphReviewHint: Review each proposed entity and relationship against its cited evidence. This records a decision only; it does not write a graph fact automatically.
knowledge.graphReviewCompleteHint: All items have a recorded decision. Complete the review to enable this governed knowledge record; graph materialization remains separately gated.
knowledge.graphReviewFailed: Could not save the graph review decision
knowledge.compilationFailed: Could not start Bid Wiki compilation
knowledge.emptyDescription: Project-shared knowledge appears here only after a manager or owner reviews it.
knowledge.emptyManagerDescription: Process source materials, then generate source-backed suggestions for review. Nothing is automatically added to the Agent's shared memory.
knowledge.loadFailed: Project knowledge could not be loaded
knowledge.loadFailedDescription: Try again. The project Agent will not use shared knowledge until it can be retrieved safely.
knowledge.ledgerDescription: Each record has a lifecycle and provenance. Proposed records never become shared Agent context without approval.
knowledge.traceEmpty: Select a knowledge record to inspect its source trace.
knowledge.approveFailed: Could not approve the knowledge record
knowledge.mapDescription: A server-projected two-dimensional trace from active shared knowledge to its cited project sources. Entity relationships remain unavailable until they are evidence-backed and reviewed.
knowledge.mapLoadFailed: Evidence map could not be loaded
knowledge.mapLoadFailedDescription: This does not change the knowledge ledger. Refresh to restore the source trace.
knowledge.mapEmptyTitle: No active shared knowledge to map
knowledge.mapEmptyDescription: Approve a source-backed knowledge record to add it to the shared Evidence Map.
knowledge.mapTruncated: This map is intentionally bounded. Open individual knowledge records to inspect the complete source trace.
